livekit-client 2.23.0 (Apache-2.0), copied from the npm package's dist/ so the teller console and the kiosk test page
work on a LAN without internet. `livekit-client.esm.js` is `dist/livekit-client.esm.mjs` renamed (so every server sends it
as JavaScript). In your real kiosk React app use `npm i livekit-client@2.23.0` instead.
